messages:
Jules (People Ops): Heads-up 1: new offer accepted for a UK-based engineer starting next month. They asked during negotiation about the company pension + whether their US 401(k) can be moved into a UK plan.

Ryan (Payroll): Quick checklist: we auto-enrol eligible UK employees on payroll by default. Need NI number, start date, and contract type (FT/PT vs contractor). Our payroll partner triggers enrollment the first pay run after the employee becomes eligible.

Asha (Benefits): To add: UK auto-enrolment criteria depend on age and earnings thresholds. Employer minimum contribution is 3% of qualifying earnings (we should link GOV.UK guidance). We usually add a short FAQ in the offer packet.

Jules (People Ops): Can someone draft the FAQ bullets we can attach to offers? Keep it short 1 page. Also want a single-sentence line about cross-border rollovers.

Carlos (Legal): For the line: "We will enrol eligible employees into the company pension scheme in accordance with UK law. Any questions about transferring foreign retirement accounts should be discussed with a personal tax adviser; the company cannot provide cross-border tax advice." That keeps it safe.

Asha (Benefits): Drafted bullets: - What auto-enrolment means; - When it happens (first eligible pay run); - Employer contribution rate (3% min); - How to opt out (link to GOV.UK opt-out form + internal HR contact); - Retro contributions: employer cannot backdate contributions prior to start/eligibility.

Ryan (Payroll): FYI payroll constraints: we can refund employee contributions if someone opts out within the statutory window; employer contributions get reversed per payroll rules. Also if they're engaged as a contractor outside PAYE we can't auto-enrol. Tell hiring lead to confirm payroll type.

Jules (People Ops): They're on employee contract, direct on UK payroll. I'll send NI and signed contract to payroll.

HRHelperBot: Task created: add "UK Pension FAQ" to offer templates (task# 7721). Assigned to Asha. Deadline: 3 business days.

Asha (Benefits): Uploaded draft to /Benefits/Internal/UK-onboarding-docs and added a plain-language Q&A. Included a non-exhaustive note: "US 401(k)s generally cannot be rolled into UK workplace pensions tax-free; options include leaving funds in the US plan or rolling to a US IRA. Please consult a cross-border tax advisor."

Carlos (Legal): Suggest adding a vendor list for cross-border tax advisors but no endorsement language: "We can share a list of advisors some employees have used; this is for informational purposes only."

Jules (People Ops): Lovely. Can you also add one sentence for the offer email: "You will be enrolled into the company pension scheme in line with UK regulations; opt-out instructions will be provided after payroll setup." Simple.

Ryan (Payroll): Note for ops: set enrollment effective date to first full pay period after start date (we'll schedule on our 2024-10-01 run unless start is earlier). Confirm NI already attached.

Asha (Benefits): Done. Ive included the GOV.UK opt-out link and a short diagram of when payroll runs vs enrollment windows.

Jules (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll update the offer template and close this thread once the FAQ link is live in the offer pack. :white_check_mark:
